abstract.p: Please note that the deadline for receipt of FAQs is 16:00 (GMT) 12 November 2020. FAQs must be submitted no later than this date. All enquiries should be submitted to the research office of the proposed Higher Education Institution/Research Performing Organisation. The Irish Research Council does not accept enquiries directly from applicants/mentors. Similar questions have been grouped below in the following themes: 1. Eligibility; 2. Application Form; 3. Applying to the Scheme.
